summary: Iteration 15 - Testing 3 new features: (1) GA4 Nango scope fix with connection_config.scopes, (2) Chart Color Theme Selector with 6 themes, (3) Bookmark AI Chat to Notes. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Nango connect session correctly uses connection_config.scopes for google-analytics and google-ads integrations
Chart theme API properly persists theme preference to user document in MongoDB
Notes API correctly handles CRUD operations for bookmark feature
ChartThemeSelector component has proper data-testid attributes for all 6 theme options
Bookmark button on AI chat messages correctly saves to notes collection with toast feedback
seed_data_creation: Test notes created and cleaned up during pytest runs
